description:
Returns a specific Coordination Issue that has associated workflow metadata.
Access is controlled by the same visibility rules as the index endpoint:
- Project Admins can access all workflow issues
- Issue creators can access issues they created
- Issue assignees can access issues assigned to them
- Workflow members can access issues for workflows they are part of

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Specifies the view to use for the response. Use 'normal' for basic fields, 'extended' for full details including viewpoints and attachments.

parameters.name: viewpoint_format
parameters.description: Specifies the format for viewpoint data. Use 'procore' for Procore format, 'bcf' for BCF format.

parameters.name: included
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Coordination Issue

title.description: Title of the Coordination Issue (max 80 characters)

is_private.description: Whether the Coordination Issue is private.

creation_source.description: Source from which the issue was created

due_date.description: Due date of the Coordination Issue

closed_date.description: Date when the issue was closed

bim_model_id.description: ID of the BIM model the issue is associated with.

viewpoint_count.description: Number of BIM viewpoints associated with the issue.

issue_type.description: Issue type of the Coordination Issue

bim_file.description: BIM file associated with the issue

source_file.description: Source document or model the issue originated from. Empty when no source is resolved.

id.description: Identifier of the source document, snapshot, or BIM file.

name.description: Name of the source document or model.

type.description: Kind of source the issue originated from.

drawing_revision.description: Drawing revision linked to the issue

title.description: Formatted title of the drawing revision

coordination_issue_type.description: Company-configurable issue type assigned to the Coordination Issue.

active.description: Whether the issue type is active.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the issue type was created.

position.description: Ordering position of the issue type.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the issue type was last updated.

global.description: Whether the issue type is a default provided by Procore.

deletable.description: Whether the issue type can be deleted.

coordination_issue_priority.description: Company-configurable priority assigned to the Coordination Issue.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the priority was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the priority was last updated.

global.description: Whether the priority is a default provided by Procore.

deletable.description: Whether the priority can be deleted.

template.description: Summary of the template the Coordination Issue was created from. Empty object when the issue was not created from a template.

display_name.description: Human-readable label combining the category name and abbreviation (for example, "Architectural > ARCH").

origin.description: Origin source for the Coordination Issue

deep_link_url.description: Deep link URL to the origin item

updated_by.description: User who last updated the issue

document_snapshots.description: Snapshots of the source documents captured for the issue.

linked_procore_items.description: Procore items linked to the Coordination Issue

linked_drawings.description: Details of drawings linked to Coordination Issue

linked_observation_items.description: Observation items linked to the Coordination Issue

id.description: ID of the document container metadata

document_container_id.description: Unique identifier of the document container

document_revision_id.description: Unique identifier of the document revision

workflows_instance_id.description: ID of the associated workflow instance

drawing_markup_preview_images.description: Preview images generated by drawings with Coordination Issue Pin

coordination_issue_bim_viewpoints.description: BIM viewpoints associated with the Coordination Issue.

custom_fields.description: Custom fields associated with the Coordination Issue

permissions.description: Permission flags for the current user on this Coordination Issue.

can_edit.description: Whether the current user can edit this Coordination Issue. Always false when the associated workflow instance is terminated or completed.

can_update_status.description: Whether the current user can change the status of this Coordination Issue. Present only when a status transition or elevation action is available.

403.description: User does not have permission to view Coordination Issues

404.description: Coordination Issue not found or user does not have visibility
